mars.datum: Topography relative to the Mars areoid; IAU2000 planetocentric, east-positive longitude.
mars.encoding: gzip signed little-endian int16 horizontal row deltas, modulo 65536; first value in each row is absolute DN
mars.caveat: Source gridding interpolates between instrument tracks. No per-cell observation counts or uncertainty layer acquired. Pixel spacing is not measurement accuracy. Search is regional terrain comparison, not rover-scale hazard or landing assessment.

moon.datum: Height relative to a 1,737,400 m sphere; Mean Earth/polar axis of DE421, east-positive longitude.
moon.encoding: gzip signed little-endian int16 horizontal row deltas, modulo 65536; first value in each row is absolute DN
moon.caveat: Source gridding interpolates between instrument tracks. No per-cell observation counts or uncertainty layer acquired. Pixel spacing is not measurement accuracy. Search is regional terrain comparison, not rover-scale hazard or landing assessment.
